notes.title: Patch 1.2 : Windows 7 crash + fix + cooldown on wrong answer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Another small update thanks to your feedback in the Discussions and Discord. Special thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38180323-%25E3%2583%2595%25E3%2582%25BF%25E3%2583%258A%25E3%2583%25AA/]フタナリ[/url] curator who reviewed the game. Provided me a lot of feedback and focusing on FUTA games so if you are interested, follow the group.

Patch 1.2:
- Most important change is an update of my Unity version to fix the issue with Windows 7 owners. I hope it will fix the crash for everybody.
- Cooldown has been reduced from 30s to 10s. I heard you guys :)
- A lot of typos/formating have been fixed (including in the tuto screens).
- The question about the windowsill was wrong and has been fixed (What element does Lory not water when she comes? >> What does get wet when Lory cums?)

notes.title: Patchnote (bug fixing, typos, QOL)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I received some feedback on Discord, Steam discussions and in the review about some bugs, typos and possible improvements.
If you are experiencing an hard crash and using Windows 7. I'm still working on a solution atm and it will be solved by tomorrow.

Here are some elements I fixed in this patch:
- Typos (watch, windowsill, stockings/tights)
- Bug Theatre : The parts 7/8 were broken making it impossible to watch the end of the video.
- Move forward/backward on main screen: I added control time button on the main screen.
